children: XCF Global detailed multiple financing actions, including two senior secured 25% original issue discount notes totaling $1,066,666 in principal and an omnibus amendment revising terms with Abri Capital, Hollywood Horizons, and Brown Stone Capital. The amendment removes obligations tied to default penalty shares, adjusts maturity, interest, and revenue prepayments, and reduces Abri’s conversion capacity; XCF will pay a $150,000 fee. Separately, the company converted $840,000 of Narrow Road debt into 3,500,000 shares at $0.24, terminating the prior note and reducing leverage.
